versions.content: Sorting criteria for Containers on the Values side Contain- ers on the Values side which have the same parameter definition shall be sorted ac- cording to the following criteria: primary sorting criterion is the index . Containers without an index are to be sorted after the containers with index . Secondary sorting criterion is the shortName of the EcucContainerValue .
